issues.title: ApiKeyConfig storage, producer and nullability match frozen Phase010
issues.originalProblem: encryptedKey was declared Prisma Json rather than String @db.Text canonical JSON; revision was deferred to Phase012 even though Phase010 requires it.
issues.resolution: encryptedKey is nonnullable String @db.Text containing RFC8785 JCS canonical JSON validated with the envelope Schema. Nonnullable Int revision is produced in Phase010 with default 0 and a nonnegative CHECK. JSON naming and sensitive-storage paragraphs consistently preserve this exception and the exact envelope fields.

evidence.detail: revision explicitly states Phase010, Int, nonnullable, default 0, nonnegative CHECK and CAS increments.
JSON naming rules explicitly distinguish the canonical JSON text envelope from Prisma Json columns.
Exact envelope fields, canonical encoding, column binding and AAD match the frozen producer contract.
Frozen producer requires encryptedKey String @db.Text, revision in Phase010 and canonical JCS envelope storage.
api-key-json-column, api-key-revision-deferred, api-key-revision-nullable and api-key-noncanonical-text each exit 1 for the intended field assertion; each restored document exits 0.

issues.title: DurableTask claim index uses canonical availableAt
issues.originalProblem: The shared task claim index used nextAttemptAt, a DataRequest ERASE continuation field absent from the canonical DurableTask schema.
issues.resolution: The index is now (status,availableAt,leaseUntil,id). The same paragraph explicitly restricts nextAttemptAt to DataRequest ERASE continuation.

evidence.detail: Canonical section 3.7 fixes the DurableTask schema with availableAt.
Phase016 first produces and reuses canonical 3.7 for the shared task implementation.
durable-task-wrong-index replaces availableAt with nextAttemptAt and exits 1 on the intended index assertion; restoration exits 0.
